Eaton Foreseer OT application generates logs into Microsoft Sentinel using MMA or AMA, use the Analytics template for creating Analytic Rules on unauthorized login attempts into the application and gain insights into login activity using the provided workbooks.

## Eaton Foreseer Application Information ##

content.title: Computers running Eaton Foreseer

content.query:
let data = SecurityEvent
| where "{Activity:lable}" == "All" or Activity in ({Activity})
| where EventID == 4624 and AccountType == 'User'
// Looking for Eaton Foreseer Events
| where ProcessName has "Foreseer"
| extend Name = extract(@'^(.*\\)?([^@]*)(@.*)?$', 2, tolower(Account));
let appData = data
| summarize TotalCount = count() by Name, Computer
| join kind=inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by Name
    | project-away TimeGenerated) on Name
| order by TotalCount desc, Name asc
| project Name, TotalCount, Trend, Computer
| serialize Id = row_number();
data
| summarize TotalCount = count() by Activity , Name, Computer
| join kind=inner (data
    | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by Name, Activity
    | project-away TimeGenerated) on Name, Activity
| order by TotalCount desc, Name asc
| project Name, Activity, TotalCount, Trend, Computer
| serialize Id = row_number(1000000)
| join kind=inner (appData) on Name
| project Id, Name = Activity, Type = 'Activity', ['Activity Count'] = TotalCount, Trend, ParentId = Id1, Computer
| union (appData 
    | project Id, Name = Name, Type = 'Computer', ['Activity Count'] = TotalCount, Trend )
| order by ['Activity Count'] desc, Name asc
